name: @ganglion/xacpx
description: 随时随地通过聊天频道（微信 / 飞书 / 元宝等）远程控制 `acpx` 上的 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agents。
author: gadzan

scripts.build: bun run clean:dist && bun run build:plugin-api && bun build ./src/cli.ts ./src/bridge/bridge-main.ts ./src/bridge/engine/runtime/runtime-worker-main.ts ./src/adapters/hermes-acp-shim.ts ./src/adapters/acp-output-guard-main.ts ./src/adapters/acp-read-only-guard-main.ts ./src/conversations/default-router-main.ts ./src/plugin-api.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --external node-pty --external fs-ext --external write-file-atomic --external acpx
scripts.build:channel-yuanbao: bun run build:plugin-api && bun run clean:channel-yuanbao && bun build ./packages/channel-yuanbao/src/index.ts --outdir ./packages/channel-yuanbao/dist --target node --external xacpx && tsc -p packages/channel-yuanbao/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:channel-feishu: bun run build:plugin-api && bun run clean:channel-feishu && bun build ./packages/channel-feishu/src/index.ts --outdir ./packages/channel-feishu/dist --target node --external xacpx && tsc -p packages/channel-feishu/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:channel-discord: bun run build:plugin-api && bun run clean:channel-discord && bun build ./packages/channel-discord/src/index.ts --outdir ./packages/channel-discord/dist --target node --external xacpx --external discord.js && tsc -p packages/channel-discord/tsconfig.json
scripts.assert:relay-protocol: node -e "const m=require('./packages/relay-protocol/dist/index.js');if(!m.MSG||!m.MSG.sessionsCreate||typeof m.encodeEnvelope!=='function'){console.error('FATAL: relay-protocol dist is missing runtime exports — the barrel (export *) was likely tree-shaken to empty. Do NOT ship this build.');process.exit(1)}console.log('relay-protocol dist exports OK')"
scripts.build:relay-protocol: bun run clean:relay-protocol && bun build ./packages/relay-protocol/src/index.ts --outdir ./packages/relay-protocol/dist --target node && tsc -p packages/relay-protocol/tsconfig.json && bun run assert:relay-protocol
scripts.build:control-bridge: bun run build:plugin-api && bun run clean:control-bridge && bun build ./packages/control-bridge/src/index.ts --outdir ./packages/control-bridge/dist --target node --external xacpx --external @ganglion/xacpx-relay-protocol && tsc -p packages/control-bridge/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:relay: bun run build:web && bun run build:control-bridge && bun run clean:relay && bun build ./packages/relay/src/cli.ts --outdir ./packages/relay/dist --target node --external ws --external hono --external @hono/node-server --external @ganglion/xacpx-relay-protocol --external @ganglion/xacpx-web --external @ganglion/xacpx-control-bridge && tsc -p packages/relay/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:channel-web: bun run build:channel-relay && bun run build && bun run build:web && bun run clean:channel-web && bun build ./packages/channel-web/src/index.ts --outdir ./packages/channel-web/dist --target node --external xacpx --external @ganglion/xacpx-web --external @ganglion/xacpx-control-bridge --external @ganglion/xacpx-relay-protocol --external @ganglion/xacpx-channel-relay --external hono --external @hono/node-server --external ws && tsc -p packages/channel-web/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:channel-relay: bun run build:control-bridge && bun run clean:channel-relay && bun build ./packages/channel-relay/src/index.ts ./packages/channel-relay/src/terminal.ts --outdir ./packages/channel-relay/dist --target node --external xacpx --external ws --external @ganglion/xacpx-relay-protocol --external @ganglion/xacpx-control-bridge && tsc -p packages/channel-relay/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:web: bun run build:relay-protocol && bun run clean:web && bun run --cwd packages/web build
scripts.build:packages: bun run build && bun run build:channel-yuanbao && bun run build:channel-feishu && bun run build:channel-discord && bun run build:relay && bun run build:channel-relay && bun run build:channel-web
scripts.publish:plugins: bun run publish:channel-yuanbao && bun run publish:channel-feishu && bun run publish:channel-discord
scripts.publish:relay-stack: bun run publish:relay-protocol && bun run publish:relay && bun run publish:channel-relay
